title: Anticipating Future Build Results with BuildPredictor
abstract: arXiv:2611.26476v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Continuous Integration (CI) is a popular programming practice for the seamless integration of code changes into the code base. Using CI, developers benefit from automated assembling and testing of the code after each commit. However, while the frequent integration and building supports developers, it also comes at the high costs of wasting time and resources for minimal changes.   In this work, we investigate the potential of reducing the drawbacks by anticipating the build outcome using machine learning techniques. In particular, we propose a random forest model with various features such as changes to the source and build code, and changes to the complexity of the code.   We observe that our model shows a good performance in an intra-project and holistic setting yielding a median MCC of 0.82 and 0.86, respectively. We also found that the most important features of our model concern the historical build result information. Additionall

translated_title: 使用BuildPredictor预测未来构建结果
translated_abstract: 持续集成（CI）是一种流行的编程实践，用于将代码更改无缝集成到代码库中。使用CI，开发人员可以在每次提交后受益于自动化的代码组装和测试。然而，尽管频繁的集成和构建为开发人员提供了支持，但它也带来了高昂的代价，即对微小的更改也会浪费大量的时间和资源。在这项工作中，我们研究了通过使用机器学习技术预测构建结果来减少这些缺点的潜力。具体而言，我们提出了一个随机森林模型，该模型具有多种特征，例如源代码和构建代码的更改，以及代码复杂度的变化。我们观察到，我们的模型在项目内和整体设置中均表现出良好的性能，中位数MCC分别达到0.82和0.86。我们还发现，模型中最重要的特征与历史构建结果信息有关。
tldr: 本文提出基于随机森林的BuildPredictor模型，利用源代码与构建代码的变更、代码复杂度变化以及历史构建结果等特征来预测CI构建结果，在项目内和整体设置中分别取得了0.82和0.86的中位数MCC，有望减少CI中因微小更改而浪费的时间和资源。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes BuildPredictor, a random forest model that anticipates CI build outcomes using features such as source and build code changes, code complexity changes, and historical build results, achieving median MCCs of 0.82 and 0.86 in intra-project and holistic settings, respectively, to reduce the time and resources wasted by CI on minimal changes.
